description:
Strong Java developer who is available for a 3-6 month contract in IL 
 · They must be able to create interfaces between applications using ESB and XML. 

 · Strong ESB experience is a must 

 
 Top Three Skills: 
 1) 5+ years experience developing with Java, JDBC, SQL, XML
 2) Experience with an Enterprise Service Bus, preferably experience with JBoss Fuse, Apache Camel (Big focus)
 3) Service Oriented Architecture and Web Services experience including design, interpretation, revision and advanced extension of WSDLs and - underlying services
 Job Description: 
 University client looking for Java developer to assist with the creation of interfaces for Campus Solutions.
 Requirements: 

 1) Extensive experience with data formatting and import processes using XML, CSV and various other file formats 

 2) Java development experience including advanced development using JDBC and SQL queries, and other identity related Java extensions 

 3) Service Oriented Architecture and Web Services experience including design, interpretation, revision and advanced extension of WSDLs and - underlying services 

 4) Experience with an Enterprise Service Bus, preferably experience with JBoss Fuse, Apache Camel 

 5) Tool experience such as Apache Maven for Build Management and Jenkins for continuous integration 

 6) Source Control such as GITLAB 

 Additional Information: 
 They will be working on creating interfaces for their new Campus Solutions implementation. So if anyone has done that before HUGE bonus! (not necessary though)
 Could pick up the GITLAB, Maven, Jenkins if they've worked with similar tools.
 


 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 3-6 months
